characterization_inventory.preparation: Analytical oleate reactions use pure OA (>99%, GC, T); a separate technical-grade OA control is also examined. Samples are collected under nitrogen during heating at approximately 60 °C intervals, with exact dwell times unreported. Sample is diluted 1:25 in dry toluene (ratio basis unspecified). The matrix is 9-nitroanthracene at 12 mg/mL in dry chloroform. Matrix, sample and dry chloroform are combined on a ground steel target in a glovebox, then transferred in a Schlenk bag. Up to 1 s of air contact cannot be excluded.
characterization_inventory.acquisition: Bruker ultrafleXtreme with Smartbeam-II laser, positive reflector mode; m/z 350–4500 and 2000–20000. FlexControl 3.3 and flexAnalysis 3.3. External calibration uses peptide II standard in 2, 5-dihydroxybenzoic acid; spectra also internally calibrated. Iron-isotope-pattern peaks selected for LIFT MS/MS.
characterization_inventory.results: Eight major complex-ion assignments; no detectable complex above 3195 Da within the searched 2–20 kDa range. Multinuclear mixed-valence iron–oleate complexes describe precursor species, not a single stock identity.
missing: Laser energy, spot/shot count, calibration residuals, replicate counts and raw spectra.

characterization_inventory.preparation: Fe(III)-source oleate headspace at 60 °C; separate air-atmosphere iron-oleate and pure-OA closed-flask controls.
characterization_inventory.acquisition: PerkinElmer Clarus 500 TCD; He 5.0 (99.999%), 85 mL/min; Supelco 5A 45/60 molecular-sieve packing; oven 230 °C and detector 200 °C.
characterization_inventory.results: S10 gives O2 integrated area 4.85% and N2 95.1%. OA-only oxygen consumption increases above 140 °C, whereas iron-oleate consumes oxygen below 100 °C. CO/CO2 production begins around 150 °C. Gas analysis supports redox, without uniquely establishing an elementary mechanism.
missing: Headspace volume/pressure, loop or injection volume, calibration to absolute concentration, and analytical-control batch amounts.

characterization_inventory.preparation: Sulfuric acid is added to the prepared carbonate source and the released gas collected in a measuring cylinder. FeCO3: 1.70 g (14.6 mmol). Nominal Fe(III) carbonate source: 1.90 g (6.51 mmol).
characterization_inventory.acquisition: Volumetric gas measurement; acid amount and gas temperature/pressure are unreported.
characterization_inventory.results: Fe(II) source gives approximately 300 mL gas versus a theoretical 320 mL, described as a 6% difference. Fe(III) source gives approximately 70 mL; authors estimate 16% Fe2(CO3)3, with the remainder probably Fe(OH)3/FeO(OH). Percentage basis is unspecified.

characterization_inventory.preparation: Particles stored under ambient conditions and partly oxidized.
characterization_inventory.acquisition: Aberration-corrected cubed FEI-Titan at 300 kV; camera length 115 mm.
characterization_inventory.results: Growth along [111] and side facets {113} from a [110] projection. S12 core FFT supports wustite; edge FFT is compatible with Fe3O4 and/or γ-Fe2O3. No separately acquired SAED panel occurs in the main article or SI.
missing: Specimen storage duration and oxidation fraction; no measured atomic coordinate file.

characterization_inventory.preparation: An octapod specimen with no exact synthesis-run assignment.
characterization_inventory.acquisition: FEI Tecnai G2 at 200 kV, Fischione 2020 single-tilt holder. Methods: −74° to +74° in 2° increments; body: ±76°. Inspect3D cross-correlation and manual tilt-axis adjustment; total-variation minimization reconstruction per reference 51.
characterization_inventory.results: Reconstruction supports eight triangular pods. This is morphology tomography, not crystallographic coordinates.
missing: Actual tilt sequence, raw projections, reconstruction parameters or code; external reference 50/51 implementation details.

characterization_inventory.preparation: An oxidized octapod; degree of oxidation may differ from the Figure 6 specimen.
characterization_inventory.acquisition: Cubed FEI-Titan at 120 kV; Fischione 2020 holder; −65° to +65° with 10° increments. Holder allowed to relax several minutes after each tilt. Direct spectroscopic tomography follows Goris et al., reference 32. Body reports 15 data cubes.
characterization_inventory.results: Fe2+-rich core and Fe3+-rich exterior with a gradual interface. Authors interpret wustite-to-maghemite oxidation through magnetite or mixed intermediates. FeTiO3 and hematite reference EELS spectra are prior reference standards, not synthesis products.
missing: Actual 15-view angle list versus 14 nominal positions; energy resolution/dispersion, dwell/dose, raw cubes and quantitative phase fractions.

characterization_inventory.preparation: Purified dispersion is filled and sealed in a capillary inside an inert glovebox to prevent subsequent oxidation.

characterization_inventory.preparation: Samples dried under inert conditions in Quantum Design P125E holders.

characterization_inventory.results: Exchange bias below approximately 200 K. Larger stars/cubes retain hysteresis at 300 K. Smaller stars have blocking temperature below 300 K and smaller cubes around 400 K as reported. Warm-up thermal lag causes a transition-temperature offset. Sample mass is absent, so plotted magnetic moments are not mass-normalized.

OA and ODE are degassed at 25 °C for 1 h at 0.5 mbar, then nitrogen-saturated for an unspecified duration.
Reagents marked as nitrogen-conditioned in the Materials list retain that qualification; no gas flow is invented.

simulations_and_models.scope: Own calculated isotope patterns and a 10% LA mixture comparison; not atomic structure labels.
Explanatory (100)/(111) terrace/step model of {113} facets; not refined coordinates.
Authors schematic growth and condition illustrations; not newly measured particles.
Projection-derived shape and valence reconstructions; not CIF crystal coordinates.
A prior simulation of spherical magnetite is cited as speculation; not performed or confirmed in this study.

evidence_conflicts.issue: 16.40 g and 157.7 mmol Na2CO3 disagree for anhydrous sodium carbonate.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Retain both reported numbers; no correction or derived concentration.

evidence_conflicts.issue: 5.69 g and 51.4 mmol FeCO3 disagree for nominal FeCO3.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Retain source pair and flag; no silent replacement.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Main prints Fe2(SO4)3·H2O, SI uses xH2O, and 15.90 g/39.76 mmol corresponds approximately to anhydrous rather than monohydrate.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Hydration unresolved; no recalculated pure Fe loading.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Prepared Fe(III) source is estimated 16% Fe2(CO3)3 with remainder probably hydroxide/oxyhydroxide, yet its charge has nominal carbonate mass/mmol.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Treat as mixed source; 16% basis unspecified; no pure carbonate assumption.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Body reports tilt range ±76 degrees; Methods reports −74 to +74 degrees in 2-degree increments.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Preserve both under their own locators.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Body says 15 EELS data cubes; endpoints −65 to +65 with 10-degree increments give 14 nominal positions.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Actual angle sequence not recoverable; no inferred extra view.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Main says highest dilution 66 vol% ODE suppresses stars; SI specifies greater than 66 vol% for the stoichiometry series.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Keep main threshold discussion separate from the SI alternative series; exact series dilution unknown.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Main states 5–350 K measurements; S21 plot extends to 400 K and text gives cubic blocking temperature about 400 K.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Retain figure-specific axis extent and reported estimate, flag scope conflict; no extrapolated numerical curve data.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Plotted neutral spacing annotated 281.69 Da, while caption/main identifies oleate as 281.24 Da.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Retain both labels and source locations; use no silently harmonized mass.

evidence_conflicts.issue: S21 calls smaller particles "smaller ODE dilution", whereas S14 shows smaller sizes at higher ODE vol%.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Magnetic samples remain unassigned to exact dilution/size.

locators: SI p.18 Figure S21 upper-right/lower-right panels
evidence_conflicts.issue: Upper-right field axis is labeled Oe, lower-right is kOe; apparent unit inconsistency cannot be settled from plot alone.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Preserve original axes; do not convert or digitize field values across panels.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Text cites Figure S11 for the high-resolution image; the actual image and FFT are Figure S12.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Use S12, with original cross-reference typo recorded.

evidence_conflicts.issue: General method holds 3–5 h; sampled morphology windows end at 40–60 min and Figure8 at56 min after nucleation.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Different scopes, not necessarily a contradiction; never concatenate full hold after an aliquot.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Figure 3a uses34 vol% ODE, while the SI matrix has30 vol%.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Distinct conditions; no merging or transferring size labels.

evidence_conflicts.issue: Authors use a common Fd-3m/cubic description and lattice parameters8.33/8.36 Å to discuss magnetite/maghemite indistinguishability. This is a cited comparison, not a refinement of every sample.
evidence_conflicts.resolution: Do not promote it to sample-resolved space-group or lattice labels; retain FFT ambiguity.

remaining_gaps: Every supplied main and SI page was read and visually reviewed. The remaining gaps are absent or ambiguous source information, rather than unreviewed pages.
No acquired SAED image is present. Figure 6b and S12c/d are FFTs.
No exact nanocrystal reactor charge, specimen-specific precursor branch, comprehensive workup, quench, isolated yield or storage history is supplied.
No exact geometrical definition of the size labels or spread statistic is supplied; raw particle measurements, histograms and counts are absent.
No measured CIF or atomic coordinates, quantified phase fractions, or universal final Fe3O4/γ-Fe2O3 assignment is supplied.
No machine-readable spectra, diffraction or magnetic curves, or tilt-series files are supplied in these PDFs. Original figures are retained; curves have not been digitized.
External referenced reconstruction algorithms and prior background recipes were not reviewed as full separate papers. They are listed explicitly under unresolved_referenced_methods.
Original figure rights remain with the source rights holders; this review does not establish a public-republication license.

mechanistic_findings.finding: Formation of oleates at 60 °C is separated by an approximately 80 K thermal window from later degradation. Little change in assigned complexes is observed over 60–140 °C.
mechanistic_findings.status: Authors interpretation of analytical series; not an exact run schedule.

mechanistic_findings.finding: At 320–350 °C viscosity and apparent boiling point rise; low-temperature complex signals later disappear near nucleation. The authors propose a cross-linked iron-oleate network that breaks down while releasing FeO monomers.
mechanistic_findings.status: Mechanistic proposal; no unique direct molecular structure of the network established.

mechanistic_findings.finding: Fast anisotropic star growth is followed by smoothing/truncation, then a slower cubic growth regime attributed to Ostwald ripening.
mechanistic_findings.status: Morphology-based growth interpretation; no independently measured monomer count or diffusion constant.

mechanistic_findings.finding: Authors report that either starting iron-source oxidation state can yield identical shape, size and crystal structure and that nanocrystal output can reach 20 g per batch.
mechanistic_findings.status: General capability statements; no individual figure is assigned a 20 g yield or a complete scale-up protocol.
